description: Price changes read from public pricing pages and matched on domain, plan name, billing period and billing mode. A row is one plan read on two dates. Rows with kind "renamed" record a plan name change, not a price change: their price fields are equal and pct is null. Prices are in USD as published; each row carries the billing mode it was read in.

since.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to last 90 days

name: price_changes
